$comment: #EXP-1638 (owner 2026-11-06): LONG-PRESS THE APP ICON ×2 (iOS `UIApplicationShortcutItem`s, Android launcher shortcuts; web and desktop have no app icon menu). Model = pure `appShortcuts` + `parseAppShortcut` (src/app-shortcuts.ts; iOS ExpCore `AppShortcuts.swift`, Android `domain/AppShortcuts.kt`), every mirror replays the `*Cases`. THE LIST: the three `statics` in order (`new-issue` = THE New issue page with its board picker, `new-chat` = THE composer on the Agent tab with the composer's own default agent row, `search` = THE Search page), then the most recent chats, newest first, with the share-targets.json direct-share filter (no chat that is an agent's own conversation, NO ENCRYPTED chat: a tree key or a sealed title never reaches the OS), so the list never exceeds `maxEntries` (the iOS Home Screen shows 4). A chat entry's title is the chat's display title, its icon `icons.chat`, its id `recentChatPrefix` + session id, and it opens that session (inbox-route.json session target). iOS sets the static ones in Info.plist (`UIApplicationShortcutItems`) and the recent ones as `shortcutItems` whenever the chats store changes; Android declares the static ones in `res/xml/shortcuts.xml` and publishes the recent ones as dynamic shortcuts (rank 0 first), next to the direct-share shortcuts it already publishes (share-targets.json; those keep their own ids, ranked after). Signed out, or an entry whose chat is gone: the app opens on its normal start screen. Multi-account: the shortcuts follow the ACTIVE account; switching accounts republishes them. Copy and icons are the app's own; no new component.

listCases.name: statics, then the newest plain chat, capped at maxEntries
only encrypted and agent chats: no recent entry

parseCases.name: a recent chat without an id
a direct-share id is not an app shortcut
